Lesson 8: The Homemaker (2)
Keywords: favour wildly gratitude
Read and try to find out why Nazma and Joynul are quarrelling.
One day Joynul looked for work in his village and in the next village. But
his luck did not favour him. He was angry—angry with everybody.
When he was back home, Nazma failed to serve his meal. That made him
shout at Nazima.
“T had a severe headache and a fever,” said Nazma.
Joynul was trembling with anger.
“The cooking is almost done. Wash your hands and feet. Ill bring the food
soon,” she said.
“Soon! It will take ages!” Joynul shouted wildly.
